simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הֶפֶךְ (H2016) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הֶפֶךְ (hephek) means a turn , i.e. the reverse First listed occurrence: Ezek 16 34.

definitions.full: H2016. hephek הֶ֫פֶךְ noun masculine the contrary, contrariness, perversity ; — absolute ׳ה Ezek 16:34 ; הֶ֑פֶךְ 16:34 ; suffix הַפְכְּכֶם Isa 29:16 (see Baer); — 1 the contrary, opposite thing מִןהַֿנָּשִׁים הֶפֶךְ וַיְהִיבָֿךְ Ezek 16:34 & there hath occurred in thee the contrary from other women ; 16:34 לְהֶ֑פֶךְ וַתְּהִי so thou hast become the contrary. 2 הַפְכְּכֶם Isa 29:16 Oh, your perversity !
